title: Nine Sides of One House
subtitle: 方面与层面 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 方面与层面（人与自我·观察与思考）
meta: 主题语境：方面与层面（人与自我·观察与思考）　|　核心词汇：aspect　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aspect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 my father considered ① every aspect of a house he could not afford, and bought it on the Tuesday. The ② aspect, meaning the side it faces and not the thing itself, was south, and he said that was nine-tenths of it; an aspect, he said, is the only part of a house you cannot change. He said the rest he could change badly.

Every  aspect of the business had been discussed nine times and decided once. Their ③ aspect — the one the surveyor wrote about — was drainage, and it cost them the kitchen; an aspect, my mother said, is the part of a thing that only appears when it goes wrong. She said the kitchen never recovered.

My grandmother used the word the other way and meant ④ the aspect of the place, by which she meant how it looked from the road. The ⑤ aspect, meaning the way a thing appears and not a part of it, is the only thing about a house that visitors judge and owners never see; an aspect, she said, is what a thing looks like to somebody who is leaving. She said she had left it eleven times.

By 1980 the ⑥ aspect he cared about had changed, and he said that was allowed. The ⑦ aspect of it that nobody had mentioned was the nine steps, and they were the reason my grandmother stopped visiting; an aspect, my father said, is a fact that has been waiting to be noticed. He said the steps had been waiting for two years.

The  aspect I remember is the light in the back room at four o'clock, which he had not mentioned once. An ⑧ aspect, he said in 1983, is not a piece of a thing; it is a way of standing so that one piece shows; every aspect, he said, belongs as much to the person looking as to the thing looked at. He said that was the argument against surveys.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 方面（一个具体方面）
C. 固定搭配：the aspect of the place 这个地方的外观、样子
D. 固定搭配：every aspect of something 某事的方方面面
E. n. 外观；样子（抽象：一事物呈现出的样子）
F. n. 方面（指没人提过的那一个）
G. n. 方面（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 方面（指他最在乎的那一个）

items.q: The aspect, meaning the side it faces
The aspect, meaning the way a thing appears
The aspect of it that nobody had mentioned

answers.why: every aspect of something 意为“某事的方方面面”，1978 年父亲把一栋他买不起的房子的方方面面都考虑了一遍，星期二就买下了。
aspect 意为“朝向、方位”，指房子朝哪一面而不是房子本身，朝向是南，他说那占了九成。
aspect 意为“一个具体方面”，他们那个方面，也就是测量员写下的那个，是排水，它让他们赔掉了厨房。
the aspect of the place 意为“这个地方的外观、样子”，祖母指的是它从路上看起来的样子。
aspect 意为“外观、样子”，指事物呈现的方式而不是它的一部分，它是房子上唯一由客人评判、主人却永远看不见的东西。
aspect 指他最在乎的那一个方面，到 1980 年他在乎的那个方面变了，他说这是允许的。
aspect 指没人提过的那一个方面，没人提过的是那九级台阶，也正是祖母不再来的原因。
aspect 为抽象总称，他说方面不是事物的一块，而是一种站法：站着，好让某一块露出来。
